subject.title: docs(xai): note consumer video endpoint (imagine-video-gen on grok.com) until developer API is available

question: Should OpenClaw public docs mention a Grok consumer web-session video endpoint while official xAI docs still document the developer video API?
rationale: The proposed wording would change provider guidance and introduce cookie-authenticated session handling, so automation cannot safely decide the public security boundary or temporary outage policy.

options.title: Keep docs developer-API backed
options.body: Remove the consumer-cookie warning and keep docs aligned with the official xAI API unless stronger live evidence justifies a separate note.

options.title: Publish a narrow outage note
options.body: Allow a dated warning only with redacted live proof, official-source context, and no implementation guidance for session-cookie handling.

options.title: Close this direction
options.body: Close the PR if maintainers do not want OpenClaw docs to steer users toward consumer grok.com endpoints.

recommendation.title: Keep docs developer-API backed
recommendation.body: Remove the consumer-cookie warning and keep docs aligned with the official xAI API unless stronger live evidence justifies a separate note.

likelyOwner.reason: The xAI video provider/docs surface and recent related history route most directly through this area owner signal.
